title: Jesse Marcel Library posts article about Greg Rogers

tellings.quote: One of the most interesting things was that I I recently found out that the Jesse Marcel Library in Montana >> has put up an article about me in their library.

plain: In 2025, Greg Rogers, a doctor billed as a NASA doctor, says he recently found out that the Jesse Marcel Library in Montana, named for a man named Jesse Marcel Sr., "has put up an article about me in their library". Rogers tells it himself, as a sign that his story has been taken up by people who keep records on UFOs.
